title: Campus liaisons
summary: We are building connections with campus clubs and sustainability offices. A liaison shares upcoming events that are open to the public or could be hosted with CCCC. A liaison also encourages collaboration with campus leaders and pushes forward initiatives on campus and within CCCC.

title: Supporting AASHE student networking session
summary: CCCC is supporting planning for the student networking session at the 2026 annual conference of the Association for the Advancement of Sustainability in Higher Education (AASHE). AASHE is a nationwide association of higher education staff and stakeholders focused on improving the environmental impact of higher education.

title: Supporting the Harvard Program for Environmental Politics forum
summary: The Program for Environmental Politics is a student-led and staff-supported initiative at the Harvard Kennedy School Institute of Politics. CCCC is supporting planning for its Fall 2026 forum.

title: Supporting the Student Sustainability Leadership Symposium (SSLS) 2026
summary: SSLS is an annual student-led event. It brings together students across the Northeast who are interested in sustainability. It highlights and supports student leadership in sustainability. CCCC is helping plan the 2026 symposium.
